correctness.rationale: The maximum CDF yields the exact two-draw generating function \(G_2(z)=(1-q)^2(1+qz)/[(1-qz)(1-q^2z)]\), whose logarithm has strictly positive and summable jump intensities. For \(n\ge3\), the second logarithmic coefficient is negative: the positive obstruction \(D_n\) has explicit positive base case \(D_3=q^2(3+6q+3q^2-q^4)\) and a strictly positive induction increment. Every convolution root of a nonnegative integer law with positive zero mass must itself have nonnegative integer support. The second coefficient of its putative large-order convolution root is therefore eventually negative, a contradiction. The bundled exact-rational checker passes 1,008 diagnostic identities; universal validity is analytical, not experimental.

value.rationale: This is a complete sharp integer-sample-size classification of additive infinite divisibility for a natural geometric extreme-order family that is already studied under DGEII/exponentiated-geometric labels. The exceptional case is a nontrivial explicit Levy-measure factorization, and \(n\ge3\) is ruled out uniformly over the continuum of q by a constructive finite-order obstruction. It separates log-concavity preserved by taking maxima from arbitrary additive convolution divisibility, a structural distinction useful in stochastic process embeddings.
